Braun ET66 calculator, 1987

The pocket calculator by Dieter Rams and Dietrich Lubs that inspired the iPhone’s Calculator app.

Context

Powerhouse Collection: Braun ET66 calculator, made 1987, designed by Dieter Rams and Dietrich Lubs, manufactured by Braun AG and made in Hong Kong; “black plastic, including a case, with round numeric and function keys.” Powerhouse, 2012/33/1.

Cult of Mac (John Brownlee, 2 May 2013): “the Braun ET66 pocket calculator, first released in 1987 … inspired iOS’s own calculator app.” Cult of Mac.

Why it belongs

An interface can imitate an object that is itself plain. The iOS calculator kept the ET66’s round-key layout and color accents, not a material texture.
